column3: ## Enter and edit multiple affiliations in the article metadata form
Setup: Open /testdrive/multiple_affiliations in its own tab and keep it open (see the first test in this testset)
Setup: In a separate tab, log in with the testdrive publisher username and password

column4: In the Authors section the field is labelled "Affiliations", with help text telling you to separate multiple affiliations with a semicolon (;)

column3: Enter Article Title "Form Multiple Affiliations", a Full-Text URL such as https://example.com/form-affs, and select the testdrive journal's ISSN
For the first author enter Name "Form Author" and Affiliations "University of Oxford ; Harvard University;;MIT"
Open the "journal_toc" link, open the "Form Multiple Affiliations" article and click "Affiliations"

column4: "Form Author" is listed once with exactly three affiliations: "University of Oxford", "Harvard University" and "MIT" - extra spaces are removed and the empty value between ";;" is ignored
